out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed clean mops store on the mop sink floor
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CFM use the rack to store the mops and allow air dry

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: THE MENU LISTS INCORRECT AMOUNTS FOR PROTEIN ITEMS.. THE VALUES PROVIDED APPEAR TO REPRESENT THE WEIGHT OF THE COOKED OR RAW PRODUCT RATHER THAN THE ACTUAL GRAMS OF PROTEIN CONTENT.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. CFM WILL CORRECT THE MENU TO ENSURE THAT THE LISTED PROTEIN VALUES ACCURATELY REFLECT THE TRUE PROTEIN CONTENT OF EACH PROTEIN., OR THE MENU CAN SPECIFY WETHER THE WEIGHT PROVIDED REFERS TO RAW OR COOKED WEIGHT.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: garlic butter sauce in steam wells at 111F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM reheated garlic butter sauce to 165F
